challenge.geowords: three app-generated words per round from the approved review words of block 2 sections 1-5 (data/dictionary/b2-section-*.json), three words from three different sections; letters on the capitals map with the rivers of section 2 (europe-countries-rivers.webp) by the section 5 rules

prompt.object: the country or river name as on the cards (name.en / name.ru in data/maps); no capitals, records or facts

speedHunt.order: random, no object repeats within a round
speedHunt.correct: +1 and the next object at once
speedHunt.wrong: the right place lights up for 0.5 s; no penalty except time; the object goes into the weak list
speedHunt.hit: a river counts within 8 CSS px of its drawn line; a country counts inside its outline or within 22 CSS px of it; the nearest object of the pool wins; a tap on Crimea or Kosovo answers nothing

excluded.why: the Ural River is not drawn on the capitals map; mountains and section-1 places are on other maps (no time to switch maps in 60 s)

speedHunt.score: objects found in the round + personal best

geowords.words: approved review words (role review) of data/dictionary/b2-section-1..5.json, each word once; three different sections per round; recently played words last
geowords.places: as the section 5 practice: centres of the 29 countries, the 20 rivers («on the Danube») and a river inside a country it crosses («on the Danube in Hungary»), the section-1 objects (not the Ural River or Crimea) only when needed; at least a third of the letters on rivers; a country named once; spacing 9% of map width
geowords.fallback: a word that cannot be laid out is replaced by the next word of another section
